title: Cosmetics

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's layout. It changes only when the layout does.

gameBuild.description: Steam build id the data was extracted from.

id.description: Set id, as used by `set` in a cosmetic.

hidden.description: True when the set is hidden in the collection screen.

id.description: Cosmetic id: the game's tag without its `Meta.Cosmetic.` prefix, for example `BlackAndGold.AK74`.

item.description: What it applies to: an item id from items.json, or an emote id (`Id.Emote.*`), or a vehicle variant for taxi liveries.

set.description: The cosmetic set or category it belongs to (`BlackAndGold`, `Emote`, `FactionLogo`, `Taxi`).

archetype.description: Weapon archetype it is for, such as `AR` or `Pistol`. Absent for emotes.

source.description: The game's table the cosmetic was read from, for example `Season01_Skins`.

items.description: One cosmetic: a weapon skin, emote, faction logo or taxi livery.

description: The cosmetic catalog: skin sets and what each cosmetic applies to. Prices and availability are not in the game files read.
